text_alt: Das ist eine Freundin von mir.

literal: 'I come from this country: {}' -- sein agrees with a plural predicate noun over a singular subject (Mein Land SIND die Niederlande, not ist), so a predicate-nominative frame is wrong for every plural name and cannot be fixed by choosing one verb form; the colon label needs no verb at all and takes the bare name for every name, article-taking or not
provenance: de-agent-v1;rewritten-for-fill-in=aus+dative would force a case-inflected article onto ~40 names; the first repair (predicate nominative, 'Mein Land ist {}.') traded that for a second defect, sein's agreement with a plural predicate noun (Duden/general German grammar: 'Mein Problem sind die Schulden' takes the plural verb) -- 'Mein Land ist die Niederlande' is as wrong as the dative was. The colon dodge (matching fr's 'Je viens de ce pays : {}.') puts no verb next to the filler, so the die/der/das inserts are no longer needed and were removed from countries/de.csv;ipa=espeak
